items.name: Mustang Active Adult Center (55+)
items.address: 1201 N. Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064 (inside Town Center)
items.what: Recreational center for adults 55 and over with a sitting area, TV and Wi-Fi, puzzles, and game tables for dominos and cards. Has a lunch program (reservations by phone), social groups, seminars, and crafts.
items.cost: free coffee stated; other costs unknown

items.name: Mustang Recreation Center
items.address: 1201 N Mustang Rd, Mustang, OK 73064 (inside Town Center)
items.what: Fitness center with an indoor walking track, group fitness classes, and crafting and hobby classes. Free equipment orientation is offered weekly.
items.access: Indoor walking track
items.cost: membership or day pass; site says it accepts SilverSneakers and Renew Active by UnitedHealthcare

items.name: Mustang Public Library
items.address: 1201 N. Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064 (inside Town Center)
items.what: City library with adult book clubs (including the Brown Bag lunch book club) and adult craft sessions such as Crafternoon. Program registration opens one week ahead.
items.schedule: Book clubs and crafts monthly; check calendar

items.name: Let's Talk About It book discussions at Mustang Public Library
items.address: 1201 N Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064
items.what: Oklahoma Humanities reading and discussion series on Oklahoma books; books are picked up at the library front desk. Upcoming sessions listed Oct 20 and Nov 17, 2026.
items.schedule: Late morning, roughly monthly in fall 2026

items.name: Wild Horse Park
items.address: 1201 N. Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064
items.what: 158-acre city park that holds Mustang Town Center, a community garden, a dog park, and pavilions. Good for a short outdoor stop combined with the library or senior center.

items.name: Wildhorse Gardens & Market
items.address: Wild Horse Park, 1201 N. Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064
items.what: City Parks and Recreation lists it as a volunteer gardening club that hosts regular farmers markets. Can be a gardening volunteer outlet or a market outing.

items.name: Mustang Western Days
items.address: Wild Horse Park, 1201 N. Mustang Road, Mustang, OK 73064 (main site; parade on SH-152)
items.what: Two-day town festival with a parade, chili cook-off, car show, square dancers, bingo, vendor booths, and a rodeo. The 2026 festival was Sept 11-12.

items.name: Dale Robertson Center
items.address: 1200 Lakeshore Drive, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Yukon's center for adults 55 and over with 35+ weekly activities including dance, fitness, art, crafts, board games, cards, and trips. Lunch is served weekdays and a shuttle runs within Yukon city limits.
items.access: Shuttle to and from the center within Yukon city limits

items.name: Mabel C. Fry Public Library
items.address: 1200 Lakeshore Drive, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Yukon's public library with print, audio, and video collections, public computers, and free Wi-Fi. Specific adult programs are posted on its events calendar.

items.name: Chisholm Trail Park
items.address: 500 West Vandament Avenue, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Tree-lined walking trails around Mulvey's Pond with gazebos, a pavilion, and places to sit. One of three connected parks used for Christmas in the Park.
items.access: Restrooms and walking tracks listed; surface not stated

items.name: Yukon Community Center
items.address: 2200 South Holly Avenue, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Hosts Wake Up and Walk (a morning fellowship walking program), a Garden Club, and Bunco, plus a weight room and multipurpose room.
items.cost: membership (Yukon Parks and Recreation membership covers city facilities); fees not stated

items.name: Yukon Historical Museum
items.address: 601 Oak St, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Local history in a 1910 school building, including a Czech history room, Yukon's Best flour mill displays, and replica doctor's office and schoolroom.
items.access: Three-story historic building; no accessibility details given, call ahead

items.name: Yukon Czech Hall Saturday dances
items.address: 205 N Czech Hall Rd, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Historic hall that has held a weekly polka dance with live music since 1930; open to all ages. Good for listening to live polka and waltz music even without dancing.

items.name: Oklahoma Czech Festival
items.address: Oklahoma Czech Building, 25 N 5th St, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Annual Czech heritage festival with a Main Street parade, polka bands, folk dancing, craft booths, and kolaches. The 2026 festival (60th) was Oct 2-3.

items.name: Yukon's Christmas in the Park
items.address: 2200 S Holly Ave, Yukon, OK 73099 (City Park, Chisholm Trail Park, Freedom Trail Park)
items.what: Over 500 holiday light displays across three connected parks; visitors can drive through or walk the trail of lights. Listed for Nov 21 to Dec 31, 2026.
items.access: Drive-through route available, so no walking is required

items.name: Yukon Freedom Fest
items.address: Chisholm Trail Park (500 W Vandament) and City Park (2200 S Holly Ave), Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Free July 3-4 celebration with live outdoor concerts, food trucks, and fireworks. The city suggests bringing lawn chairs or blankets.

items.name: Chisholm Trail Watering Hole & Historic Marker
items.address: 2100 S Holly Ave, Yukon, OK 73099
items.what: Monument marking a Chisholm Trail water stop used for over 30 years by cattle drives; near picnic facilities and the Yukon Community Center. A short history stop.

items.name: Lakeview Market
items.address: 9025 N Overholser Drive, Yukon, OK (north side of Lake Overholser on Route 66)
items.what: Farm market selling local food and artisan goods, with spring plants, summer u-pick flowers, a fall pumpkin patch, and a December Christmas Village.

items.name: El Reno Senior Citizen Center
items.address: 401 S. Grand Ave., El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: City-run senior center with a coordinator on staff. The state DRS guide also lists in-town transportation for people 55+ to shopping and appointments (call ahead).
items.schedule: Mon-Fri, late morning to early afternoon

items.name: El Reno Carnegie Library
items.address: 215 E. Wade St., El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: Historic Carnegie library with books, audiobooks, DVDs, public computers, and Wi-Fi. The city page mentions educational programs and community events without listing adult ones.
items.schedule: Mon-Sat (Saturday mornings only); no Sunday hours listed

items.name: Canadian County Historical Museum
items.address: 300 S Grand Ave, El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: Museum complex centered on the restored Rock Island Depot, with a one-room school, jail, hotel, caboose, and General Sheridan's headquarters.
items.access: No accessibility details on site; call 405-262-5121
items.schedule: Wed-Sat; closed Sun-Tue and federal holidays

items.name: Heritage Express Trolley
items.address: Departs Canadian County Historical Museum, 300 S Grand Ave, El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: A restored 1924 trolley run from the historical museum; the museum says private rides can be scheduled by phone or email.

items.name: Historic Fort Reno Visitor Center & Museum
items.address: 7107 W Cheyenne St, El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: Historic 1874 military post with 25+ National Register structures, a museum, and a cemetery with Buffalo Soldier, Indian Scout, and WWII POW graves.
items.access: Listed as ADA compliant

items.name: El Reno Fried Onion Burger Day Festival
items.address: 110 S Bickford Ave, El Reno, OK 73036 (downtown)
items.what: Downtown festival where a giant fried onion burger is cooked and shared out, with a car and motorcycle show, vendor booths, and live entertainment.
items.schedule: First Saturday in May (2026 was May 2)

items.name: Sid's Diner
items.address: 300 S Choctaw Ave, El Reno, OK 73036
items.what: Long-running Route 66 diner known for El Reno-style fried onion burgers, malts, and coneys. A familiar local lunch outing.

items.name: Schrock Park
items.address: West Main Street, Tuttle, OK 73089
items.what: Tuttle's main city park with picnic areas, public restrooms, and a rodeo arena; hosts the Tuttle Rodeo and an Easter egg hunt.
items.access: Public restrooms listed; no other accessibility details

items.name: Piedmont Public Library
items.address: 1129 Stout St. NW, Piedmont, OK 73078
items.what: Has hosted Oklahoma Humanities Let's Talk About It book discussion series. Current program calendar could not be loaded.

items.name: Piedmont Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting
items.address: Location not stated (City of Piedmont)
items.what: Annual city event to start the holiday season with horse-drawn carriage rides, food trucks, and photos with Santa.

items.name: Bethany Library (Metropolitan Library System)
items.address: 6700 NW 35th Street, Bethany, OK 73008
items.what: Branch library with public computers, a makerspace, adult craft programs, and free museum Experience Passes. MLS has listed an Alzheimer's Association caregiver support group here.
items.access: StoryWalk starts at Cecil Mendenhall All Abilities Park; library invites accommodation requests

items.name: Bethany YMCA
items.address: 3400 N. Mueller Ave., Bethany, OK 73008
items.what: YMCA branch offering SilverSneakers classes (chair-supported, music-based) plus an indoor pool and group exercise classes.
items.access: Chair-supported class option

items.name: Eldon Lyon Park
items.address: 7400 NW 36th St, Bethany, OK 73008
items.what: 60-acre city park with 1.5 miles of walking trails, picnic tables, and reservable shelters.
items.access: No accessibility details given

items.name: Warr Acres Library
items.address: 5901 NW 63rd Street, Warr Acres, OK 73132
items.what: Branch library with take-home creative writing and mindfulness kits for adults. MLS has listed the S.A.L.T. Council (seniors and law enforcement scam-awareness group) meeting here monthly.
items.schedule: Daily (Sunday afternoons); S.A.L.T. first Monday monthly per MLS 2024 post

items.name: Rockwell Plaza YMCA
items.address: 8300 Glade Avenue, Oklahoma City, OK 73132
items.what: YMCA branch with an indoor pool and group exercise. Senior-specific classes are not listed on the branch page.

items.name: Patience S. Latting Northwest Library
items.address: 5600 NW 122nd Street, Oklahoma City, OK 73142
items.what: Branch library with adult workshops (for example Woodcarving 101 in Oct 2026), outdoor patios, and free museum Experience Passes.

items.name: Healthy Living OKC (MAPS 3 Senior Health and Wellness Center)
items.address: 11501 N Rockwell Ave., Oklahoma City, OK
items.what: Wellness center for adults 50+ with group fitness, arts and crafts, dancing, cooking classes, seminars, support groups, and social events. One of four city-owned MAPS 3 senior centers.

items.name: Bert Cooper Trails (Lake Hefner)
items.address: Around Lake Hefner between NW Grand Boulevard and Hefner Road, Oklahoma City
items.what: 9.8 miles of asphalt and concrete multi-use trail around Lake Hefner; easy to walk a short section and turn back.
items.access: Paved (asphalt and concrete); part follows the dam road shared with vehicles

items.name: Lake Hefner accessible fishing piers
items.address: Lake Hefner: enclosed piers north of marina breakwater, NW end of Firemen's Cove, SE corner of Lion's Children's Playground; covered pier at north end of marina
items.what: City-listed accessible fishing docks and piers, including enclosed and covered piers.
items.access: City lists these among its accessible fishing docks and piers
items.cost: City fishing permit required ages 16-61 (so not required 62+); state license still required

items.name: Lake Overholser
items.address: 1800 Overholser Dr, Oklahoma City, OK 73155 (as listed)
items.what: City lake with picnic areas, restrooms, a fishing dock and covered fishing pier, and a nature trail. Eastern shore has gentle drive-up access.
items.access: Listed ADA compliant with handicapped parking; covered fishing pier at SW corner (city fishing page)
items.cost: free admission; fishing permits apply under age 62

items.name: Overholser Trail and Hefner-Overholser Trail
items.address: East side of Lake Overholser from NW 39th St and Overholser Dr to Overholser Park at NW 10th St; connects north to Lake Hefner
items.what: 3.2-mile lakeside trail along Lake Overholser that links to the 7.8-mile Hefner-Overholser Trail.
items.access: Surface not stated on city page

items.name: Route 66 Park
items.address: 9901 NW 23rd St, Oklahoma City, OK 73141 (as listed)
items.what: 148-acre park on Lake Overholser with about a mile of walking trails, three ponds with wetland boardwalks, an observation tower, and fishing.
items.access: Listed ADA compliant with handicapped parking

items.name: Stinchcomb Wildlife Refuge
items.address: NW 51st St & N Stinchcomb Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73008
items.what: 1,000-acre refuge north of Lake Overholser popular for bird watching and fishing.
items.access: No accessibility details given; better for birdwatching from the edge than long walks

items.name: Will Rogers Gardens and Ed Lycan Conservatory
items.address: 3400 NW 36th St, Oklahoma City, OK 73122 (as listed)
items.what: Free horticultural gardens with a historic conservatory of cacti and succulents, a color garden, an arboretum, a duck pond, and fee-based gardening classes.
items.access: Listed ADA compliant with handicapped parking and restrooms

items.name: Will Rogers Senior Center
items.address: 3501 Pat Murphy Drive, Oklahoma City, OK 73112
items.what: OKC Parks senior center offering art, card games, dance, exercise, sewing and quilting, poetry and writing, yoga, travel, and health and financial planning; has an art studio and mobile library.

items.name: Belle Isle Library
items.address: 5501 N Villa Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73112
items.what: Branch library with a makerspace (sewing and embroidery machines), adult craft sessions, and the free Total Wellness class from the OKC-County Health Department.
items.access: Adult changing station; drive-up book drop

items.name: The Village Library (SAIL exercise class)
items.address: 10307 N. Pennsylvania Avenue, The Village, OK 73120
items.what: Hosts SAIL (Staying Active and Independent for Life), a fitness program for older adults that can be done sitting or standing; registration required.
items.access: Seated option

items.name: Southern Oaks Library
items.address: 6900 S. Walker Avenue, Oklahoma City, OK 73139
items.what: Branch library offering Beginners Line Dancing for adults (Oct 2026) and, per MLS, an intermediate Tai Chi class.

items.name: The Ninety-Nines Museum of Women Pilots
items.address: 4300 Amelia Earhart Dr, Ste B, Oklahoma City, OK 73159
items.what: Museum on the second floor of the Ninety-Nines headquarters at Will Rogers World Airport, covering women in aviation including Amelia Earhart's belongings.
items.access: Listed ADA compliant; museum is on a second floor, call ahead

items.name: Regional Food Bank of Oklahoma Volunteer Center
items.address: 3355 South Purdue, Oklahoma City, OK 73179
items.what: Volunteers sort and pack food for food bank programs; shifts are posted three months ahead and require registration. Closed-toe shoes required.
items.access: Hope's Kitchen is kept at 55 degrees; dress warmly

items.name: YMCA Healthy Living Center (50+)
items.address: 13660 S Western Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73170
items.what: MAPS 3 wellness center for adults 50+ with an indoor pool, indoor track, group exercise, art classes, a demo kitchen, and pickleball.
items.access: Indoor track; caregiver changing rooms

items.name: Crystal Lake fishing dock
items.address: 6625 SW 15th St, Oklahoma City
items.what: City-listed uncovered fishing dock on the south side of Crystal Lake, along the West River Trail area.
items.access: Listed on city accessible fishing docks page
items.cost: City permit required ages 16-61; state license required

items.name: Pete White YMCA (50+)
items.address: 4021 S. Walker Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73109
items.what: MAPS 3 wellness center for adults 50+ with an indoor pool, track, group exercise, art classes, and a senior nutrition program.
items.access: Caregiver changing rooms

items.name: Myriad Botanical Gardens and Crystal Bridge Conservatory
items.address: 301 W. Reno, Oklahoma City, OK 73102
items.what: Downtown gardens with the Crystal Bridge tropical conservatory; outdoor grounds open daily.
items.access: Free wheelchairs available (first come); mobility scooters welcome
items.cost: Conservatory $9 seniors 62+; grounds fee not stated

items.name: Oklahoma History Center
items.address: 800 Nazih Zuhdi Drive, Oklahoma City, OK 73105
items.what: State history museum near the Capitol; the Research Center is useful for family history.
items.access: Wheelchair accessible parking; complimentary wheelchairs at admissions desk

items.name: National Cowboy & Western Heritage Museum
items.address: 1700 NE 63rd St, Oklahoma City, OK 73111
items.what: Large museum of Western art and history with indoor galleries and outdoor gardens.
items.access: All areas wheelchair accessible; free wheelchairs first come

items.name: Science Museum Oklahoma
items.address: 2020 Remington Place, Oklahoma City, OK 73111
items.what: Hands-on science museum; good for an outing with grandchildren.
items.access: Not stated on tickets page

items.name: Farmers' Market at Scissortail Park
items.address: 415 S Robinson Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73109
items.what: Saturday farmers market inside Scissortail Park downtown.

items.name: Metropolitan Library System Library by Mail
items.address: Mail delivery service (no visit needed)
items.what: Free book delivery by mail for seniors 65+ or homebound patrons of the Metropolitan Library System. Useful at-home activity between outings for Oklahoma County residents.
items.access: Home delivery
